current_topic.scope: Prepare for ordinary sick days at home: food, everyday comforts, contact, appointment logistics and pet care. No treatment, symptom assessment or urgent response.

user_context.current_request: i want to udnerstand US medical system

reviewed_guidance: Prepare before ordinary sick days. No clinical decisions, medication choices or emergency response.
Use current choices to prioritize; unknown details and unchecked concerns are not automatic exclusions. Offer useful related discovery.
A directory is a lead, an inquiry is pending, and an arrangement needs confirmation. No availability or protection guarantees.
Researching a paid service is not buying it. Honor an explicit no-paid-services limit; a broad cost preference only affects priority.
Learning counts: explain one useful distinction or unfamiliar route without requiring a call, purchase, quiz or trial.
Pet species, benefits, helpers and planned treatment remain unknown unless supplied. Use conditional wording; practical dependencies still matter.

eligible_resources.name: HHS — finding telehealth
eligible_resources.purpose: Explore first-visit routes and what to check.
eligible_resources.limits: Ask the provider about new patients, location, coverage and personal cost. No appointment is arranged.

eligible_resources.name: HRSA — health-center finder
eligible_resources.purpose: Find a US health center to investigate.
eligible_resources.limits: Centers serve insured and uninsured people. Ask about fees, new-patient access and whether virtual first visits are offered.

eligible_resources.name: Medicaid — transport information
eligible_resources.purpose: Learn about a possible nonemergency transport benefit.
eligible_resources.limits: Only for eligible beneficiaries; state and plan rules vary. Not an emergency service or a procedure escort.

eligible_resources.name: 211 — local community resources
eligible_resources.purpose: Discover local practical support and referral routes.
eligible_resources.limits: Information and referrals do not guarantee assistance. Check local eligibility, cost and availability.

eligible_resources.name: CVS — prescription delivery
eligible_resources.purpose: Investigate pharmacy delivery as one possible route.
eligible_resources.limits: Check the actual pharmacy, prescription eligibility, charges and handoff. No medicine choice or delivery-time promise.

eligible_resources.name: Feeding America — local food help
eligible_resources.purpose: Find a local food-assistance starting point.
eligible_resources.limits: Ask the local program about eligibility, access and any delivery. A listing is not confirmed help.

eligible_resources.name: 211 — local community resources
eligible_resources.purpose: Find your local US 211 to research practical community support, including food and transportation assistance.
eligible_resources.limits: 211 provides information and referrals, not a booked service. Eligibility, prices and availability of referred programs vary. No check-in or emergency response is promised.

eligible_resources.name: Rover — pet sitter research
eligible_resources.purpose: Compare potential paid drop-in sitters for cats or dogs in your area before you need one.
eligible_resources.limits: Research is free; bookings cost money. Coverage, prices, pet types, experience and dates vary. A listing is not a confirmed booking or guarantee of suitability.

eligible_resources.name: HHS — preparing for telehealth
eligible_resources.limits: Technology, support and phone alternatives depend on the provider.

eligible_resources.name: MedlinePlus — procedure preparation
eligible_resources.purpose: Understand why a procedure may require an escort.
eligible_resources.limits: For an explicitly planned procedure; the care team determines the actual arrangements, not this app.

eligible_resources.name: CMS — understanding care estimates
eligible_resources.purpose: Learn what a written estimate may cover.
eligible_resources.limits: US nonemergency self-pay information, not individual legal advice or a guarantee of the final bill.

eligible_resources.name: CVS — refill and renewal help
eligible_resources.limits: Other pharmacies differ. Follow professional instructions; do not change medication or infer refill timing.

supported_concerns.label: Food and essentials without going out
Knowing where to get care, and what it costs
Help with errands and things at home

collection_outcomes.title: Find a pet sitter worth contacting
collection_outcomes.outcome: One potential sitter and a question are saved, or the care gap is clearly noted.

collection_outcomes.title: Find a care option you can actually start with

collection_outcomes.title: Know how your first video visit will work
collection_outcomes.outcome: You understand the joining requirements and where to ask about support or an alternative.

collection_outcomes.title: Find a way to an appointment without driving
collection_outcomes.outcome: You have an eligible transport option with confirmed booking and return-trip details. An unanswered inquiry is still pending.

collection_outcomes.title: Check what 'someone to take you home' really means
collection_outcomes.outcome: Your procedure team has confirmed an acceptable arrangement. An unresolved gap or a ride booking alone isn't completion.

collection_outcomes.title: Find out whether a pharmacy can reach your door

collection_outcomes.title: Understand why a refill might need another step
collection_outcomes.outcome: You understand refill versus renewal and know where to ask if a request stalls.

collection_outcomes.title: Learn how prescription collection by someone else works
collection_outcomes.outcome: You understand the potential route, its limits and which pharmacy requirements still need confirmation.

collection_outcomes.title: See whether groceries can reach your actual door
collection_outcomes.outcome: You understand one service's total order cost, delivery location and substitution options well enough to decide whether it fits.

collection_outcomes.title: Find food help without a delivery budget

collection_outcomes.title: Choose meal delivery that actually removes cooking

collection_outcomes.title: Take one last-minute shop off your future plate
collection_outcomes.outcome: That specific supply gap is covered and you have a simple cue to replace it when used.

collection_outcomes.title: Find a reliable answer to food-storage questions
collection_outcomes.outcome: You can find storage guidance matching that food and know where to look again.

collection_outcomes.title: Decode a laundry pickup service's real cost
collection_outcomes.outcome: You understand the charging model and the service terms you would check before ordering.

collection_outcomes.title: Understand what a cleaning booking actually includes
collection_outcomes.outcome: You know how to check whether a cleaning service includes the work you actually need.

collection_outcomes.title: Find help for an errand you can't postpone

collection_outcomes.title: Make a check-in something you both want

collection_outcomes.title: Learn which kind of home help fits
collection_outcomes.outcome: You understand the service types and which kind of provider to ask about your stated need.

collection_outcomes.title: Discover local help beyond people you already know
collection_outcomes.outcome: You know a local starting point and how to investigate one relevant type of support.
